description: Every planfile TicketStatus value and its class, for consumers that classify queues without importing planfile (e.g. monag resume, fleet admission). A status missing here is a contract defect, not an unknown value to tolerate.

classes.ready: Pending work that may be picked up now.
classes.claimed: Pending work held by an executor.
classes.stalled: Pending work that needs triage before anyone may pick it up again; never ready.

failed.note: Execution attempts exhausted; it may be reopened.
